secrets.name: OMEGA_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing key for /v1/attest (>=32 chars). A dev placeholder is provided in .env.base44-defaults; replace with a real random key for trustworthy attestations.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: BotFather token for Telegram intake (BotFather → /newbot → token). Optional: without it GET /v1/telegram/status answers UNCONFIGURED and POST /v1/telegram/webhook halts NOT_EXECUTED without touching KAI memory.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret passed to Telegram setWebhook as secret_token and returned in the X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header (any random string). Required before the webhook accepts an update, so an unauthenticated caller cannot plant intents in KAI memory.
